content.rendered:
2025-26 Regular Monthly Board Meetings

  • TIME: All regular meetings begin at 6:00 p.m., unless otherwise noted on agenda.
  • LOCATION: Unless otherwise noted on agenda, meetings will be held at the District Office Board Room (21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140).

List of Meetings 2025-26

  • September 15, 2025
  • October 13, 2025
  • November 17, 2025
  • January 12, 2026
  • February 9, 2026
  • March 9, 2026
  • April 13, 2026
  • May 11, 2026
  • June 1, 2026

Special Board meetings, work sessions, and executive sessions may be added during the academic year as needed, and meeting times and locations are subject to change. If additional meetings are added a public notice will be distributed in advance. 

Archives of meeting agendas and approved minutes can be viewed below. Please note that meeting minutes for each month are approved at the following month’s meeting, and will be posted following that approval. Full video archives of all public meetings can be viewed on our YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3 starting the day following the meeting.

For more information or accommodations, please contact Board Secretary Dani Sticka in the Superintendent’s Office at 503-825-5002, or at dsticka@sherwood.k12.or.us.
